data.name: Emlen
data.gender_notes: Emlen is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Emlen is derived from the Old English word ‘eam’ meaning ‘em’ and ‘lén’ meaning ‘strength’ or ‘helmet’. This name conveys the idea of a precious jewel or treasure that is also strong and protected. The name Emlen carries the meaning “Jewel of strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Emlen usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel of strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emlen total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
